label: Pre-encounter — a traveler walking the wrong way
location: The highland pass, above the road

recentEvents.value: The roost-bells have sounded; fledglings are being moved along the cliffs.
A traveler is walking the wrong way on purpose, uphill, armed.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps walking into weather.

temporaryObjective.value: Turn the traveler: point the downhill road, block the wrong turns.
